name: Fish and Chips
reasons: Technique grilled -> fried; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Cut potatoes into thick chips. Double-fry: first at 160°C for 5 minutes, then at 190°C for 3 minutes until golden.
Make batter: whisk flour, baking powder, salt, and cold beer until smooth.
Pat cod dry, season, and dust lightly with flour.
Dip in batter and fry at 180°C for 5–6 minutes until batter is puffed and golden.
Drain on paper towels. Serve with hot chips, tartare sauce, lemon, and malt vinegar.

name: Focaccia
reasons: Technique fried -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
Include 120 min stretch-and-fold period and 45 min tray rest, plus 25 min baking. Optional overnight refrigeration for best flavour is excluded.

steps.display_text: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and water. Add olive oil and knead for 8 minutes. Place in an oiled bowl.
Stretch and fold the dough 4 times over 2 hours. Refrigerate overnight for best flavour.
Transfer to an oiled baking tray. Stretch gently to fill the tray. Rest 45 minutes.
Dimple all over deeply with your fingers. Drizzle very generously with olive oil.
Top with rosemary sprigs, sliced garlic, and flaky sea salt.
Bake at 230°C for 20–22 minutes until golden. Eat warm.

name: French Fries
reasons: Include the mandatory 30 min potato soak.
Remove the under-30 tag because corrected elapsed time exceeds 30 minutes.

steps.display_text: Peel and cut potatoes into even sticks. Soak in cold water for 30 minutes to remove starch.
Drain and dry very thoroughly — water causes dangerous oil splashing.
First fry at 160°C for 5 minutes (blanching). Remove and drain. They should not be golden yet.
Heat oil to 190°C. Fry again in batches for 2–3 minutes until deeply golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and season immediately with sea salt. Serve at once.

name: French Onion Omelette
reasons: Ingredients, description and instructions contain mushrooms and no onions; correct the title without changing ID or slug.

steps.display_text: Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter until golden. Set aside.
Whisk 3 eggs with a pinch of salt until uniform.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Pour in eggs.
Using a spatula, gently pull cooked egg from the edges to the centre, tilting pan to let raw egg flow underneath.
When surface is just barely set (still slightly glossy), add mushrooms and cheese to one half.
Fold omelette in half and slide onto a plate. Should be pale golden, never brown.

name: French Onion Soup
reasons: Allow 45 min onions + 15 min simmer + 4 min broil, rounded to 65 min cooking.

steps.display_text: Slice onions thinly. Melt butter in a heavy pot and add onions with a pinch of salt.
Cook on medium-low heat for 35–45 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until onions are deep golden.
Deglaze with white wine, scraping up browned bits. Add stock, thyme, and bay leaf.
Simmer for 15 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, and a splash of brandy if desired.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls. Place a baguette slice on top. Cover with grated Gruyère.
Broil under high heat for 3–4 minutes until cheese is bubbling and slightly charred.

name: Fresh Spring Rolls
reasons: Technique fried -> raw; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Cook rice vermicelli according to package. Rinse in cold water and drain well.
Julienne carrot and cucumber. Slice avocado thinly.
Fill a large bowl with warm water. Dip one rice paper for 10–15 seconds until soft.
Lay on a damp surface. Place herbs first, then noodles and vegetables on the lower third.
Fold bottom up, fold sides in, and roll forward tightly. Serve with peanut-hoisin dipping sauce.

name: Fërgesë (Albanian Pepper Stew)
reasons: Technique braised -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Roast peppers over a flame or under a broiler until charred. Peel and slice.
Dice tomatoes. Sauté in olive oil with chili for 5 minutes.
Add roasted peppers. Mix well and transfer to an oven dish.
Dot cottage cheese over the surface.
Bake at 190°C for 25–30 minutes until the cheese melts into the sauce.
Scatter fresh basil. Serve hot with bread for scooping.

name: Gazpacho
reasons: Technique simmered -> raw; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
No heated cooking; retain 15 min hands-on work and include the mandatory 120 min chill.

steps.display_text: Roughly chop tomatoes, cucumber, and pepper. Soak a slice of stale bread in water.
Blend all vegetables with garlic, soaked bread, sherry vinegar, and olive oil until smooth.
Season with salt. Add a splash of cold water to adjust consistency.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until very cold. Serve in glasses with diced vegetable garnish.

name: Guacamole
reasons: Technique fried -> raw; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Halve and pit avocados. Scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork to desired texture — leave it a little chunky.
Finely dice red onion, jalapeño, and tomato. Chop cilantro.
Fold everything in with a squeeze of lime juice and a generous pinch of salt.
Taste and adjust: more lime for brightness, more salt to season. Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

name: Halva (Balkan Semolina Dessert)
reasons: Technique baked -> pan_fry; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Make syrup: combine sugar, water, cinnamon sticks, and cloves. Bring to boil and simmer 5 minutes.
In a separate pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add pine nuts and fry briefly until golden.
Add semolina and stir constantly over medium heat for 5–7 minutes until it turns a deep golden colour.
Step back and carefully pour the hot syrup into the semolina — it will bubble vigorously.
Stir quickly until all liquid is absorbed. Cover and rest for 5 minutes.
Press into moulds or a bowl. Invert onto a plate. Dust with cinnamon and serve warm or at room temperature.
